exposure: Marginal or velamentous umbilical cord insertion
Pre-delivery maternal body mass index >=25 kg/m2
outcome: Life-threatening severe postpartum hemorrhage (hemorrhage exceeding 1500 mL)
cohort: 315 singleton vaginal deliveries following frozen embryo transfer from 2017 to 2022.
finding: The developed predictive score, based on four identified risk factors, demonstrated moderate sensitivity and high specificity in identifying severe postpartum hemorrhage in vaginal deliveries following frozen embryo transfer.
birth_weight: Birth weight >= 3500g was a risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage
